title: Advanced Perioperative Hemodynamic Monitoring and Clinical Outcome
summary:
During an operation, intervention or critical care therapy relevant changes in cardio-circulatory function may occure. 
Until now it remains unclear weather different methods to obtain cardio-circulatory data are comparable and what impact the use of such devices has on postoperativ patient outcome. 
Additionally to devices used in clinical routine a non-invasive messurement via electrical cardiometry [electrical monitoring of cardio-circulatory function] (ICON®, Osypka Medical) will be established in this clinical trial.  
This study aims to assess comparablitiy of data obtained by the different devices and analyse impact on postoperative patient outcome.

interventions.name: hemodynamic parameters (CO, MAP, CI, SVRI, SV, SVV, PPV, etc.) obtained by electrical cardiometry (ICON®) and FloTrac® during an operation, procedure and/or stay at on a intensive care unit with data point of at least every 30 seconds.

hemodynamic parameters (CO, MAP, CI, SVRI, SV, SVV, PPV, etc.) obtained by electrical cardiometry and ClearSight® during an operation, procedure and/or stay at on a intensive care unit with data point of at least every 30 seconds.

hemodynamic parameters (CO, MAP, CI, SVRI, SV, SVV, PPV, etc.)obtained by by electrical cardiometry (ICON®) and PiCCO® during an operation, procedure and/or stay at on a intensive care unit with data point of at least every 30 seconds.

hemodynamic parameters (CO, MAP, CI, SVRI, SV, SVV, PPV, etc.)obtained by electrical cardiometry (ICON®) and TTE/TEE during an operation, procedure and/or stay at on a intensive care unit with data point of at least every 30 seconds.

hemodynamic parameters (CO, MAP, CI, SVRI, SV, SVV, PPV, etc.) obtained by electrical cardiometry (ICON®) and pulmonary catheter during an operation, procedure and/or stay at on a intensive care unit with data point of at least every 30 seconds.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients undergoing operations or interventions with anaesthesiological participation
Patients receiving advanced hemodynamic monitoring 
informed consent for participation
Exclusion criteria:
refusal to participate in the study 
contraindications for hemodynamic monitoring via electrical cardiometry
